She is bastardized and bound and for a moment the scene alternates between excitement and fear. But everything resolves itself in the end, as it should.

Title: 854. Heaven Is Round the Corner
description: After Joan's father remarries, she goes to Paris, where her uncle arranges singing lessons for her.

Title: 855. Il cappello da prete
description: The Baron of Santafusca, an aging playboy, has squandered his fortune is about to get arrested for unpaid debts. He decides to lure a greedy priest to his crumbling ancestral estate outside of Naples and murder him for his money.

Title: 857. De tre skolekammerater
description: Herluf, Eyvind and Ove are friends from school. Ove's son, Henrik, has a groundbreaking invention in which Herluf invests for his glass company, and Herluf's daughter is interested in Henrik for private reasons. But when the invention fails at a large demonstration, it cracks in Herluf and Ove's friendship - so much so that they end up in front of Eyvind, who is the judge.

Title: 858. Parbat Pe Apna Dera
description: Meera Devi played by Vanmala is a beautiful, rich heiress who is blind and seeks refuge with her father in Bhagwaan Shiva's temple. There she meets an "ascetic" Ram Babu played by Ullhas who has no worth for worldly pleasures or people, having devoted himself to worship of the god Shiva. Meera pleads with him to allow her to serve him and he takes pity on her and restores her eyesight with his holy medicine. With love and gratitude she starts serving him and they fall in love and get married. Introduced to the pleasures of life, Ram Babu is waylaid and seeks extra-marital pursuits. Distraught Meera drives him away from her house and his eyes get burnt during Dassehra festivities while chasing her friend. It is then he realizes his mistakes and once again seeks refuge in God. Will Meera be able to re instate her lost love?

Title: 859. El hombre que las enamora
description: Fernando Galán is a rich widowed man with a handsome son, Eduardo. Four times he has been engaged to a younger woman, but marriage fails as soon as they meet Eduardo. This time both father and son plan a different strategy : Eduardo pretends he is traveling abroad so his father will have freedom; and the father, in turn, gets engaged to a girl he purposely wants to leave alone with his son.

Title: 861. How to Fly the B-26 Airplane
description: Documentary feature film depicting the training of young Lieutenant Jim Anthony as a pilot of the B-26 Marauder bomber. Dick, the captain charged with pilot instruction, leads Jim through every aspect of preparation to fly the bomber, going through a detailed checklist of pre-flight procedures, long before he allows Jim to turn an engine over. Once preparations are completed, Dick shows Jim the process of starting the engines, followed by take-off. In the air, further instruction helps Jim understand the various limits and capabilities of the aircraft. When one engine fails, Dick must simultaneously guide the limping plane back to a safe landing and explain to Jim each step of the procedure.

Title: 862. Das Konzert
description: A concert pianist, the romantic idol of many women, is seduced away from his wife. The seductress's husband takes in the pianist's wife, and all four pretend to be happy with the new arrangement.

Title: 865. Det bødes der for
description: At a forest restoration, somewhere in the province, a bunch of newly-graduated students celebrate their well-graduated exam.

Title: 868. Five Were Chosen
description: A story of Yugoslav villagers trying to free five of their citizens held hostage by the Nazis during World War II.

Title: 869. Spiel mit der Liebe
description: Joseph dreams of owning a theater but his stingy wife won't have it. So he seeks the aid of Dr. Hall who got rich playing roulette with an alleged system. Hall refuses - until he meets the enticing singer of the future stage enterprise.

Title: 870. To dromaki tou Paradeisou
description: The brief chronicle of a great love between two young people.

Title: 871. Vändkorset
description: The small town of Gåtatorp in Småland is entirely dependent on its prominent furniture factory. But the factory is in danger because the weak economy means that the bank wants to shut down the factory.

Title: 874. Aventura
description: Andrés, a peasant, falls in love with Ana, the star of the small troupe that will stage Lope de Vega's Peribáñez. Andrés -married to Flora and father of a child- and Ana will live their inner conflict as people in the village gossip around

Title: 883. Tre ragazze cercano marito
description: A couple, owners of a pension, are concerned with finding a convenient party for their three daughters. The girls, however, have already set their sights on three attractive guests.

Title: 892. Sondhi
description: Dinanath, a blind, rural actor, wants his son Suresh to marry Vani, the daughter of his neighbor and close friend Janardan. Suresh works as a lawyer at the Calcutta High Court. A wealthy landlord addressed as Roy Bahadur asks Suresh to marry his petulant daughter Rekha in exchange for a large sum of money, but Suresh refuses. Suresh then overhears a conversation between his father and Navin Chakraborty, and learns that Dinanath borrowed a large amount from Navin Chakraborty to sponsor his college education, and their property, including their ancestral house, is mortgaged to Navin Chakraborty. Navin believes Dinanath cannot repay the loan because he will not get a large dowry if Suresh marries Vani, who comes from a poor family. He threatens to take the matter to court unless Dinanath repays the debt soon. To clear the debt, Suresh goes to Roy Bahadur and agrees to marry Rekha for the money. After receiving the payment, he returns to his village and pays Navin Chakraborty. He then visits his father to tell him the debt is cleared but does not get a chance to explain how he got the money. Later, he writes to Janardan that he cannot marry Vani. This news deeply upsets Janardan and infuriates Dinanath. Dinanath, accompanied by Janardan travels to Calcutta to dissuade Suresh, but when they reach Roy Bahadur's house, they discover that Suresh has already married Rekha. Heartbroken and furious, Dinanath disowns Suresh and leaves with Janardan. On the way home, Janardan dies in an accident, which makes Dinanath resent Suresh even more. After this, Dinanath decides to arrange Vani's marriage into a suitable family. He takes on many acting jobs to save enough money. During this time, he has a serious fight with Prankesto, a fellow actor who dislikes him as his acting career is affected because of Dinanath's popularity as an actor. Prankesto maligns Suresh infuriating Dinanath who injures his head. Prankesto files a police complaint claiming that Dinanath tried to kill him. Dinanath is called to court and is shocked to discover that Suresh is his lawyer. Although Suresh wins the case for him, Dinanath still refuses to forgive his son. On the way home, Dinanath and his wife Rajlakshmi are stopped by Rekha who manages to reconcile the father and the son restoring peace in the family.

Title: 895. Naissance d'une cité
description: A medium-length film on the evolution of the Belgian capital from the tenth century.

Title: 898. Rainbow Round the Corner
description: Variety show comprising musical and dance acts.

Title: 899. Guds mærkelige veje
description: Hans Jørgen (Jørn Jeppesen) is a carpenter's apprentice who seeks spiritual values beyond the work of the day. When his mother dies, he is thrown into a crisis. Neither his father (Poul Secher) nor his employer (Peter Nielsen) can comfort him. Pastor Holm (Poul Petersen) becomes the one to lead him back to the Christian life values that his mother stood for. His friendship with the healthy and natural girl Lisbeth (Signi Grenness) also proves to be important.

Title: 900. Un muchacho de Buenos Aires
description: A singer is employed in a nightclub to find his mother's murderer and in addition to doing so, he marries a singer.

Title: 911. La vida de los ferroviarios y sus colegios de huérfanos
916. Mumtaz Mahal
description: Mumtaz Mahal showcases the love story of Mughal emperor Shah Jehan and his favourite wife Mumtaz Mahal, and the former's efforts to create Taj Mahal for housing the tomb of Mahal after her death.

Title: 922. Ni pobre, ni rico, sino todo lo contrario
description: A rich man is determined to loose his fortune so her beloved will accept him; when he finally does she turns him again for being too poor. He then allies with his new companions to recover a better position in life.

Title: 926. Murallas de pasión
description: "Walls of Passion" - A love triangle of which the beach and the sea will witness.

Title: 927. Die Hochstaplerin
description: Thea can't pay her bill, so the hotel manager forces her to impersonate a countess to draw business to the hotel. Then Thea and lawyer Michael meet and fall in love but he insists he could marry only a strictly law-abiding woman.

Title: 930. Pocestné paní Pardubické
description: A story about the petty bourgeoisie and the gloss of Baroque bourgeois society, which falsely clings to the former view of the city executioner, covers its own vices with the Catholic faith and, in its stupidity, allows itself to be robbed

Title: 931. Dynamiittityttö
description: Mysterious dynamiters keep the city in fear. Spoiled Marja Reijonen longs for excitement in her boring life and gets excited about the crimes because the dynamite men are so up-to-date.

Title: 932. U peti veverek
description: Landlady Filomena tries to change an old house with a memorable history to a paid garage. Her husband Josef stops her with help of his young friends.

Title: 933. Teatertosset
description: Waitress Dorrit, full of life and smiles, finally gets her break in theater the day she gets fired as she gets help from a customer as well as friends.

Title: 934. Kluci na rece
description: On the banks of the Otava River stands a manor house, which a group of boys find very mysterious. After visiting it, the boys discover that there is nothing here but an old lady with her granddaughter. The group splits into two camps and "hot" fights ensue, but they don't last long.

Title: 935. Nászinduló
description: The memory of the first, unfulfilled love still haunts Miklós, the once poor schoolboy, and Éva, the mayor's daughter, who were separated by social barriers in the past, and now by family ties.

Title: 936. Räkna de lyckliga stunderna blott
description: The dressmaker Annemarie and the upcoming businessman Victor falls in love. But Annmaries simple background is not good enough according to Victors family.

Title: 937. Vaivaisukon morsian
description: Elias, who is preparing for his wedding, dances drunk with a beggar in front of the church and dies of a heart attack. His fiancée Anna is devastated by grief and on the verge of suicide. In his despair, he experiences a religious awakening, which is supported by Antti, who is in love with Anna, and some of the villagers. The pastor sees the revivalist movement as a threat to himself, the church, and public order.

Title: 938. Nevideli jste Bobíka?
description: Bobík, the dear fox terrier of a currently absent rich lady is lost. Her relatives offer lots of money to whoever can find him, making people with ulterior motives and similar looking dogs cause a lot of confusion.

Title: 939. Nainen on valttia
description: Fed up with her hectic life style, a famous operetta singer escapes from her selfish fiance to a misogynistic household of three men: a professor, a composer, and their bibulous servant.

Title: 940. Machita
description: A female spy goes to Budapest to steal the plans of an anti-aircraft gun.

Title: 941. Tristezas Não Pagam Dívidas
description: While grieving her husband in a cemetery, a widow meets a smart widower and tells him that she has inherited a large amount of money from her husband. The small time crook convinces her to go to a beauty shop and he moves to her apartment, going to parties, theaters, restaurants and casinos with her. The widow brings her son Carlinhos (Oscarito), who lives in a mental institution, to live with them.

Title: 942. Anja tule kotiin
description: Mauri Miettinen and his wife Anja are living in a happy marriage. Everything changes when Mauri's old acquaintance comes to visit and threatens to reveal Anja's dark past.

Title: 943. Szováthy Éva
description: Vienna, 1848. The celebrated belle of the ball is Éva Szováthy, who at this evening finally decides in favor of her love for Doczy Lénard. History and fate, however, put up partitions between the Viennese courtier and the rebel captain. When Lénard leaves Vienna for Nagydóc because of the revolutionary events, Éva, the daughter of the imperial chamberlain, follows him, where she is not welcome. All the more so because the patriotic family had chosen a like-minded noblewoman, Eszter Girálthy, as Lénárd's fiancée.

Title: 945. Law of the Valley
description: Two cowboys arrive in Green Valley in answer to a letter from an old friend, find the friend murdered and the town controlled by crooks. The cowboys trace the origin of this situation to the railroad planning a spur through the valley.

Title: 946. Le merle blanc
description: Monsieur Leroy, big boss of the shoeblack company of the same name, is harsh with every member of the personal but with one: Camuset, a worker somewhat simple, some even call him a simpleton. Gossip and is running about this mysterious tenderness towards a very humble member of the team. Some whisper that Camuset might be a natural son of the general manager. The truth is totally different and linked to a family secret that Camuset, less naive than people think will find out and exploit to his advantage and that of his friend Jean who is deeply in love with Lucienne, the boss daughter.

Title: 952. Den heliga lögnen
description: Helen Wahlman is the hostess of a luxury hotel in the mountains. Her husband fled to Chile 15 years ago, after being guilty of fraud, and was killed there. Helen's image of marriage is just dark memories. A few days before Christmas, Helen gets a shock, her husband appears from the dead at the hotel.

Title: 953. På farliga vägar
description: Martin and Märta seem to have a happy marriage, but Märta feels neglected. One evening she meets Martin's colleague, Frenchman Barthou, famous for his success with the Stockholm ladies, and he starts to flirt with her.

Title: 955. Altar mayor
description: Javier and Teresina, a simple village girl, fall in love during his stay in the Asturias countryside recovering from an illness. He promises to marry her before the Covadonga Virgin altar. Back in Madrid, Javier's mother has other plans for his son, to marry him to a marquise. Time goes by and all of them return to Asturias, and Javier must now decide on his future.

Title: 956. Ballaadi
description: At the request of the author Zacharias Topelius, Fredrik Pacius begins composing an opera, inspired by a summer walk in Backas, Espoo. Pacius becomes infatuated with Ebba Duncker, who sings by the lake like a nightingale from a young mermaid. Pacius' infatuation, despite being married, causes a scandal in Helsinki's high society circles.

Title: 958. L'enfant de l'amour
description: This woman's melodrama pivots around a child that a famous actress had in her youth, but whom she has concealed from the wealthy businessman she is now with.

Title: 959. Hasret
description: A composer who makes sacrifices for the girl he loves.

Title: 960. Starlight Serenade
description: Brian Michie introduces various musical and comedy acts in the form of a dress rehearsal for a stage review, interspersed with comedy routines featuring Bonar Colleano.

Title: 961. Die Zaubergeige
description: Violinist Andreas plays his cheap fiddle in second-rate orchestras. When a priceless Stradivari is displayed in the museum he gets obsessed, steals it and fascinates his audiences with his art. But the theft didn't go unnoticed.

Title: 967. Garabatos Claudette Colbert
description: Short animation film from the series 'Garabatos'.

Title: 969. Geogyeong jeon
description: A whaling vessel hunts its quarry on the open sea while its crew undergoes many hardships. During the course of their journey, they dream of their wives and families and pray for the chance to provide for the loved ones and nation.

Title: 970. Velikaya pobeda pod Leningradom
description: Recounts the defeat of German troops near the city of Leningrad.

Title: 974. United States
description: Military training documentary narrated by actor David Niven during his time away from Hollywood to serve in the Army, and produced to instruct British troops in the history of their American allies.

Title: 981. Villmarkens lov
description: A reindeer company is being robbed for reindeer, and the police hasn't got a clue, and a new investigator is sent. The thieves want to get rid of him, but things don't go as planned.

Title: 983. És a vakok látnak...
description: Irma is in love with Balázs. She is pregnant. He can't handle the responsibility and asks her to abandon the child. Irma can't. Balázs is sent to the front.

Title: 984. Quinito, futbolista
description: Short film from the series 'Quinito'.

Title: 985. Garabatos Imperio Argentina
description: Short animation film from the series 'Garabatos'.

Title: 989. Rositza
description: Toma is owner of sawmill. Rositza is a distant relative of Toma and works as a housekeeper in his house. Rositza is in love with Dobri, Toma's son, but her status does not allow her to reveal her feelings. Besides, Dobri is engaged to Elena, daughter of a prosperous merchant. A few days before wedding Dobri retu8rns home drunk. In the morning paper he reads that the previous night a man was stabbed to death with a pocket-knife. He discovers that his pocket-knife fits the description in the paper with its broken blade. Dobri confess everything to Elena and her parents. Elena will not marry a criminal. Dobri describes his predicament to Rositza and declares his love to her. Rositza goes to Elena and explains her that Dobri is innocent: some time ago Rositza herself broke the knife. Meanwhile the real killer had been caught. Dobri learns from Elena of Rositza's visit. Dobri catches up her on the path and takes her into his arms.

Title: 993. Celebes - Kaigun hôdôhan'in no hôkoku: Kiroku-hen
